description: V0.3.6 real-world validation inputs. Each clip is different footage from a different camera, so each carries its own explicit camera_id: nothing in the harness combines counts or identities across them. No clip has a physically measured floor calibration, so every one is processed in normalized image units and no metre, m/s or subjects/m^2 figure is derived for it. A future physically measured scene is added by appending an entry with a 'calibration_path', not by changing validation logic.

clips.notes: Elevated fixed camera, daylight, moderate occupancy. The reference scene the other three are stated relative to.
High occupancy with sustained mutual occlusion and a populated far field.
Night scene under strong artificial light, with high contrast between lit and unlit regions.
Low-resolution head-on corridor view at 25 FPS. Subjects enter and leave frame frequently, which is the scene type where track births are most confounded with genuine arrivals.
